production.note: Calendar years, following the existing Chiron record (no source stating US model years was found). Bugatti's release of 8 June 2021: delivery "is scheduled to start early 2022" (bugatti-css-release); first customer deliveries announced 4 April 2022. Last: the final (500th) Chiron, "L'Ultime", is "a Super Sport", announced 30 May 2024 (bugatti-chiron-end). The 30-car Chiron Super Sport 300+ is a different variant and is not part of this record.

body.note: Two-seat fixed-roof coupe with an extended "longtail" rear, "by approximately 25 centimeters"

displacementL.note: 7,993 cc: Evo spec table "W16, 7993cc, quad-turbo"; Bugatti says "8.0-liter"

aspiration.note: Evo: "quad-turbo"; Bugatti mentions "modifications to the turbochargers"

drivetrain.note: TFLcar: "Power still makes its way to all four wheels through a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic"

powerHp.note: Quote (Bugatti release, 8 June 2021): "Bugatti thoroughly overhauled the 8.0-liter W16 engine for the Chiron Super Sport, boosting its performance by 100 PS to 1,176 kW/1,600 PS." 1,600 x 0.98632 = 1,578 hp. Evo's spec table agrees: "1578bhp @ 7050-7100rpm" (evo-css); TFLcar prints 1,577 hp (tfl-css). No separate SAE rating for the US was found, so powerStandard is DIN PS.

weightLb.note: Step 2 (major magazine spec panel). Quote (Evo, Steve Sutcliffe, 19 May 2023, Chiron Super Sport v Rimac Nevera spec table): "Bugatti Chiron Super Sport | 1995kg"; text: "The Bugatti is more than 300kg lighter at 1995kg to the Rimac's 2300kg." Evo marks dry figures as dry and does not here, so it is read as a kerb weight (guide, "Unlabelled weights"). 1,995 x 2.20462 = 4,398 lb. Bugatti's release gives no total, only that "the vehicle weight was reduced by a further 23 kilograms". Single configuration. Caution: 1,995 kg equals the base Chiron's widely used figure (the existing Chiron record's 4,400 lb), while Bugatti says the Super Sport "was reduced by a further 23 kilograms", so Evo may have printed the base car's figure. The checker reports that autotijd.be also gives 1,995 kg; that page's weight table could not be opened in this pass and is not cited.
